\section{Introduction}
Neural models retrieve code from natural language queries \cite{gu2018}, and mutants stand in for real faults
in testing studies \cite{just2014mutants, just2014defects4j}. Code review \cite{bacchelli2013} and distributed
development \cite{bird2009} shape software quality. Fault localization \cite{wong2016} and automatic repair
\cite{legoues2012, brennan2009} build on the naturalness of code \cite{hindle2012}. Large language models now
reach most software engineering tasks \cite{hou2024}. Cohesion metrics for aspects \cite{kumar2008}, flaky test
repair \cite{hartmann2023}, and defect prediction \cite{zhao2024} complete the picture.

\section{Conclusion}
This sample closes with its references.
